_source.title: 获取坐标点的图元
_source.remarks.text.0: 本操作和前端鼠标点击操作类似，将会获取指定坐标点上的图元
_source.returns: 坐标点的图元，如若坐标点无法找到图元，将返回 `undefined`

title: Get The primitive at the coordinate point
remarks.text.0: This operation is similar to clicking with the mouse on the front end; it will get the primitive at the specified coordinate point
returns: The primitive at the coordinate point. If no primitive can be found at the coordinate point, `undefined` will be returned
